column1: # lib/coding-agents.tsv — the coding agents whose live sessions are never touched.
# ONE list, read by both sides: `lib/live-sessions.sh` (the cleaners' exemption)
# and the app's `CodingAgentHosts` (what Monitor locks and the cleanup review
# keeps). A session's ROOT is a running program that matches one of these
# lines; every process that descends from a root belongs to the session.
# `agent-runner --probe-agents` fails if the two sides ever disagree.
# An agent that is NOT listed here is NOT protected (it fails open): its
# sessions look like any other dev tooling. Add a line to protect one.
#   kind  exe       the executable's file name is exactly `text`
#         fragment  the command line contains `text` (plain text, not a pattern);
#                   with `also`, it must contain that too
#         ignore    the executable is never a session root (a search helper)
